svg.title: Hybrid threat detection and scoring architecture
svg.desc: A pipeline showing multi-layer log ingestion, parallel rule-based and ML detection, score fusion, and incident output with explainability and playbook generation.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do we normalize network flow logs?')
sendPrompt('What do endpoint process logs look like?')
sendPrompt('What HTTP log fields matter for detection?')
sendPrompt('What does the unified event schema look like?')
sendPrompt('What rules should we write for brute force and C2 beaconing?')
sendPrompt('Which ML models work best for network threat detection?')
sendPrompt('How do we combine rule-based and ML scores into one confidence score?')
g.text: score = 0.4 × rule_hit + 0.6 × ml_prob | cross-layer boost: +0.2 per correlated layer

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What should an incident alert card contain?')
sendPrompt('How does SHAP generate plain-English threat explanations?')
sendPrompt('How does the LLM generate a dynamic prevention playbook?')
